[Benzinga news, 2026-10-24T02:01:53Z, by staff] MarketAxess Addresses Shareholder Complaints Regarding Planned ICE Merger
MarketAxess has publicly dismissed shareholder complaints concerning its planned merger with Intercontinental Exchange as being without merit.
MarketAxess Holdings Inc. has stated that shareholder complaints regarding its planned merger with Intercontinental Exchange (ICE) are "without merit." The statement follows reports of formal objections raised by shareholders concerning the acquisition. The merger remains a significant pending transaction involving ICE's strategic expansion.
